feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 209 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: 3D Print Price Calculator — Price a Print for Etsy or Shopify
entry.summary: Free calculator for makers selling 3D-printed parts: price one print from filament, electricity, printer depreciation, failed-print rate, and post-processing labor, then check whether your marketplace fee and target margin actually clear at the price you're charging.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Cache Poisoning Check — Fork-Writable Cache & restore-keys
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find actions/cache steps reachable from pull_request_target/workflow_run, and restore-keys fallbacks that can adopt a poisoned prefix match. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Injection Check — Pwn Requests & Script Injection
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find pull_request_target/workflow_run 'pwn request' checkouts and shell script-injection from untrusted ${{ github.event }} expressions. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Actions Permissions Check — Does Your GITHUB_TOKEN Use Least Privilege?
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every workflow or job with no explicit permissions block (running on the ambient default) or permissions: write-all. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Actions Runner Starvation Check — Is Your Red CI Even Real?
entry.summary: Paste the JSON from a GitHub Actions run and find out in one click whether a red check is a real failure or GitHub silently never assigned it a runner. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Actions Self-Hosted Exposure Check — Is Your Self-Hosted Runner Exposed to Forks?
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job that runs on a self-hosted label in a workflow triggered by pull_request, pull_request_target, workflow_run, or issue_comment — the exact pattern GitHub's own docs warn against on public repos. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: ADA Title II Website Accessibility Evidence Report
entry.summary: Turn a government website's axe-core JSON scan into a dated WCAG 2.1 AA evidence record for ADA Title II, split into required findings and best-practice extras. Runs locally in your browser.

entry.title: AI Crawler Access Check — Which AI Bots Does Your robots.txt Block?
entry.summary: Paste your robots.txt and find out in one click whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, and 11 other named AI crawlers are allowed, blocked, or partially blocked — plus a structural check of your llms.txt. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Daycare Tuition Calculator
entry.summary: Free daycare and childcare tuition calculator. Price a classroom from your own child:staff ratio, staffing cost, and overhead, and see what an empty seat actually costs you at every occupancy level.

entry.title: Coverage Drop Check — Did This PR Lower Line Coverage?
entry.summary: Paste two Cobertura or JaCoCo coverage XML reports — baseline vs this PR — and see whether line coverage dropped, and which files got worse. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded. A floor like --cov-fail-under=80 misses a drop from 92% to 81%.

entry.title: Dependency Confusion Check — pip --extra-index-url & Unscoped npm Names
entry.summary: Paste your requirements.txt, pip.conf, package.json, and .npmrc and find the two configuration shapes behind every 2021 dependency-confusion incident: pip --extra-index-url, and an unscoped npm dependency name behind a private registry. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded, no network calls.

entry.title: Flaky Test Finder — Which Tests Flipped Between CI Runs?
entry.summary: Paste two or more JUnit XML test reports and find out in one click which tests are flaky (pass one run, fail the next) versus genuinely broken versus stable. Free, runs entirely in your browser, works with pytest, Jest, Go, PHPUnit, RSpec, and Maven/Gradle Surefire — nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Gig Driver Net Pay Calculator — What You Keep After Gas
entry.summary: Free calculator for DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, Uber, and Lyft drivers: turn one session's gross pay into real net pay per hour and per mile after gas, maintenance, and insurance, plus a tax set-aside.

entry.title: KDP Royalty Calculator — KU Page Reads vs Going Wide
entry.summary: See what a Kindle book keeps on KDP exclusive (paid sales plus Kindle Unlimited page reads) versus going wide. Paperback print cost, 70% vs 35% ebook, and Ingram wholesale are boxes you type from your own dashboard. Free, runs in your browser.

entry.title: License Drift Check — Did a Dependency's License Change Since Your Last Snapshot?
entry.summary: Paste two snapshots of your dependency tree's declared licenses (npm, pip, cargo, go) and find out in one click which packages changed license since the last one — the change Dependabot and Renovate do not flag. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: npm Lifecycle Script Check — Did a Dependency Just Start Running Code at Install Time?
entry.summary: Paste your package-lock.json and see every package that runs a preinstall, install, postinstall, or prepare script at install time -- and, with an older lockfile, exactly which ones started doing that since your last check. npm audit does not flag this. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Pinned Actions Check — Are Your GitHub Actions Pinned to a Commit SHA?
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every third-party action referenced by a mutable tag like @v4 instead of a pinned 40-character commit SHA. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Pour Cost Calculator
entry.summary: Free pour cost calculator for bars and restaurants: price a cocktail from your own bottle costs and pour sizes, see the liquor cost percentage against your target, and find out what over-pouring is really costing you a year. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: VS Code Extension Drift Check — Did an Extension You Trust Just Change What It Does?
entry.summary: Paste a snapshot of your installed VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or VSCodium extensions and see exactly which ones changed their activation surface -- a new startup trigger, a new extension dependency, or a changed entry point -- since your last check. A CLI-only command also checks whether an extension still resolves on the VS Code Marketplace. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Whatnot Seller Payout Calculator — Keep After 8% + Processing
entry.summary: Free Whatnot seller fee calculator. Commission on the hammer, processing on the checkout total (item + shipping + tax) plus $0.30, the $1,500 TCG cap, leftover after the label, and whether free shipping is cheaper. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: ATM Route Margin Calculator — Price Each Placement
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent ATM route operators: find real monthly profit per location after the surcharge split, processor fees, and vault cash cost of capital, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

entry.title: Card Processing Fee Audit — Split Your Statement Into Interchange and Markup
entry.summary: Read five numbers off your merchant statement and see how much of your card processing bill is network interchange you cannot negotiate and how much is processor markup you can. Free, private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Custom Farm Rate Calculator — Price Custom Field Work Per Acre
entry.summary: Free calculator for custom farm operators: find the rate to charge per acre for combining, planting, spraying, baling, or tillage work, from your own machine speed, width, fuel, repairs, ownership cost, and labor — then check a season of jobs against an income goal.

entry.title: Dog Walking & Pet Sitting Rate Calculator — Price Your Route
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent dog walkers and pet sitters: price a walk, drop-in, or overnight from time, drive, mileage, extra pets, and overhead, then see your monthly route revenue and the gap to your income goal.

entry.title: Dumpster Rental Margin Calculator — Price a Roll-Off Job
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent roll-off dumpster rental operators: price a rental from the included weight allowance, tipping fee, labor, and mileage, then check whether your overage rate actually covers your own disposal cost before a heavy load erases the margin.

entry.title: Equipment Lease Buyout Calculator — Buy Out vs. Return and Replace
entry.summary: Compare the true monthly cost of buying out an equipment lease against returning it and replacing it, using fair market value and remaining useful life. Free, private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Fire Extinguisher Inspection Route Margin Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent fire-extinguisher and life-safety inspection route operators: find real monthly profit per customer site after recharge, hydro-test, and replacement materials, tags, drive time, and recordkeeping cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

entry.title: Home Staging Bid Calculator — Price a Vacant Listing
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent home stagers: price a vacant-listing staging job from the included term, furniture carrying cost, crew labor, and mileage, then check whether your extension fee actually covers your own carrying cost before a slow listing erases the margin.

entry.title: Ice Dam Removal Bid Calculator — Price a Steam Removal Job
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent ice dam removal contractors: price a job from linear feet of roof edge, crew size, an emergency/storm premium, and a minimum service charge, then check whether your per-foot rate card actually covers this job's largely fixed cost before a short call quietly loses money.

entry.title: Locksmith Bid Calculator — Price a Service Call
entry.summary: Free calculator for mobile locksmiths: price one service call — lockout, rekey, lock install, or fob programming — with the after-hours premium and minimum service charge built in, then check whether today's calls hit your income goal.

entry.title: Pet Grooming Bid Calculator — Price a Dog or Cat Groom
entry.summary: Free pet grooming price calculator: size, coat, matting, add-ons, and mobile travel go into one transparent quote with break-even and target-margin price.

entry.title: Photo Booth Event Quote Calculator — Price a Booking
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent mobile photo booth operators: find the real price for one event booking after setup/teardown time, travel, attendant labor, unlimited-print risk, and equipment cost, then check a price you're already considering against the breakeven.

entry.title: Vehicle Wrap Bid Calculator — Price a Wrap Install
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent vehicle wrap and graphics shops: price a full or partial wrap from vehicle surface area, material waste factor, install complexity, and labor, then see exactly what a waste-blind quote loses on every job.

entry.title: Vending Machine Route Profit Calculator — Price Each Location
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent vending machine route operators: find real profit per location after commission, card fees, shrink, drive time, and machine cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

entry.title: Which Job First? Free Pairwise Job Priority Ranker for Contractors
entry.summary: Paste your job list, answer a handful of this-or-that questions, and get a ranked work order. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser with no account.

entry.title: Vendor Change Watch — See What Changed in a Vendor's Terms
entry.summary: Paste a vendor's terms, privacy policy, or subprocessor page. Come back later, paste it again, and get a section-by-section diff of what changed. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Security Camera Installation Bid Calculator — CCTV Storage
entry.summary: Price an IP security camera install from the drops, the cable, and the labour — and check the three things a camera bid gets wrong: days of recording the drives actually hold, PoE load against the switch budget, and runs past the 328 ft Ethernet limit.

entry.title: Shop Rate Calculator
entry.summary: Work out your real labor burden, your overhead rate on direct cost, and the hourly rate a trade job has to be sold at — from your own payroll, vehicles, office and materials. Free, private, and it fills in the burden and overhead fields on every bid calculator here.

entry.title: Appointment Deposit Calculator for Service Businesses
entry.summary: Free appointment deposit calculator for salons, trainers, tutors, photographers, and other service businesses. Set a deposit, see the balance due, check whether it pays for itself against your no-show rate, and draft your policy.

entry.title: Marketplace Fee Comparison — Which Channel Nets Most
entry.summary: Free side-by-side comparison of eBay, Etsy, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and your own Shopify store on one item. Enter the price and your landed cost once and see net profit on every channel. Runs entirely in your browser.
